packageRules.description: The runtime image is distroless (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian13), which ships Debian trixie's Python 3.13; keep .python-version on that minor so CI tests what ships. Lift together with the distroless/Debian base.
apache-airflow-client 3.x targets only the Airflow 3 REST API (/api/v2); 2.x is kept while the operator supports Airflow 2 (/api/v1). Lift when Airflow 2 support is dropped.
